skillDispatch.when: Using or changing TypeScript libraries, frameworks, runtime APIs, or configuration.
Writing or reviewing TypeScript tests and fixtures.
Diagnosing TypeScript failures or unexpected runtime behavior.

rules.guidance: Use current authoritative documentation before changing TypeScript library APIs, framework configuration, runtime behavior, or dependencies. Keep type errors visible and preserve the repository's package and lockfile workflow.
Test observable behavior and explicit failure modes. Do not make mocks, snapshots of incidental output, private structure, or type assertions the source of correctness.
